summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for TPS5430DDAR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8E, buck): evaluated 25 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 8 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 0 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 8 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

candidates.key_tradeoff: Not drop-in: fixed vs adjustable output feedback footprint mismatch (R1/R2 divider); Higher Iq (5000 µA vs 2000 µA)

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (buck, external Schottky diode), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (GND) on SOIC-8E.
Re-verify switching frequency (500 kHz), inductor value (15 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (1.221 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
